snippet.title: Red Spiral 64
snippet.description:
Playing LossForWord's Red Spiral 93 with Doom 64 monsters from DeathMachine and my D64 texturepack, also Cosmobyte's ambience

Mapset is Chainworm Commando

Red Spiral is a pretty interesting gameplay mod because I don't think I've ever seen J-Horror themed Doom mods before
